adjusted_prescription: To improve the agent's ability to avoid fires by following the top-edge corridor, it needs new corrective demonstrations that start at or very near the top-left corner of the environment, such as positions (0,0), (0,1), or (0,2). These demonstrations should clearly show the agent moving consistently to the right along the top edge throughout the episode. It is important that these demos include a variety of randomized fire setups that keep the top edge clear, so the agent learns to trust this safe corridor. Providing 4 to 6 such demonstrations will help the agent robustly learn to commit to the top edge and successfully avoid fires under different conditions. This focused training is essential because current demonstrations either start in other areas or do not emphasize the required rightward movement along the top corridor. By adding these targeted demos, the agent can reliably reach its goal while minimizing fire collisions in dynamic layouts.
